crosscheck.route: live rollout on the model's OWN states, against the teacher-forced probe's behaviour-policy states

probe.limitation: The probe measures sensitivity on BEHAVIOUR-POLICY states -- the distribution the conditioning was learned on, and not the distribution the DT visits when it drives. The crosscheck bounds that gap for exactly one cell by rolling the model live under the grid's two endpoints; it does not close it for the other 39.

role: P5.3a: teacher-forced sensitivity of the trained DT's ACTIONS to the return prompt, plus the two Gate-0 tables P5.3b's registration needs. Measured quantities only; the reading belongs to the coordinator and lives in docs/returns/P5.3a.md
